addedProviders.name: USFS Sumter National Forest Neal Shoals canoe access and Upper Broad Blueway map
addedProviders.method: USFS identifies Neal Shoals Dam Canoe Access as a portage. The Upper Broad Blueway map places parking at the end of Shoals Road (FS 304) and says river access is a 500-foot walk from parking to avoid the dam. The stored coordinate remains a generalized access-area anchor; it is not asserted to be the ramp toe or exact end of the carry.

controls.name: Neal Shoals Dam public access / 500-foot carry area
controls.coordinateText: Generalized site anchor; map places parking at the end of FS 304 and describes a 500-foot walk to river access. Keep boats and people away from dam and tailrace.

addedProviders.name: City of Sioux Falls Farm Field Park kayak and canoe access
addedProviders.method: The City lists Farm Field Park kayak/canoe access and publishes 43.5028832,-96.749131 with a boat-launch photo and park hours. The published point identifies the public park/access facility, not a surveyed water-edge point; retain as an access-area anchor.

controls.name: Farm Field Park kayak and canoe access area
controls.waterbody: Big Sioux River / Skunk Creek confluence area
controls.coordinateText: City-published park coordinate and paddle-access amenity; access area only, not a verified launch toe.

addedProviders.name: Iowa DNR Bluffton Fir Stand canoe-access parking area
addedProviders.method: Iowa DNR describes the W20/Bluffton Road parking area beside the Upper Iowa River as canoe access only. The route point is an access-area anchor; the page does not publish an exact launch-toe coordinate, and the route name no longer calls the parking-area point a ramp.

controls.name: Bluffton Fir Stand canoe-access parking area
controls.coordinateText: Iowa DNR identifies canoe-only access from the nearby W20 parking area; coordinate is not an exact water entry.

addedProviders.name: City of San Marcos City Park river access
addedProviders.method: The City identifies City Park river access and permits visitors to bring kayaks and canoes. The stored facility point is a park/access-area anchor, not a published or surveyed water-entry point; parking rules and fees depend on residency and current City notices.

controls.name: San Marcos City Park river access area
aliases: San Marcos City Park paddle access
controls.coordinateText: Municipal facility coordinate/access-area anchor; verify current river-side carry and parking conditions.

addedProviders.name: BLM McKay’s Bend Recreation Site access area
addedProviders.method: BLM identifies McKay’s Bend as a developed Clearwater River recreation site with river access and parking; the page coordinate matches the stored site point. Treat it as the developed access-area anchor, not a surveyed water-entry edge, and confirm site operations and shoreline conditions.

controls.name: McKay’s Bend Recreation Site river access area
controls.coordinateText: BLM-developed recreation-site coordinate; public river-access anchor, not a surveyed ramp-toe point.

addedProviders.name: Vermont Fish & Wildlife Otter Creek–Kwonumosk access
addedProviders.method: Vermont Fish & Wildlife GIS returns feature OID 238 / id 357, AccessName “Otter Creek - Kwonumosk,” waterbody Otter Creek, town Weybridge, manager F&W, access type Boating/Fishing and ramp type Steps. Geometry is x=-73.2472,y=44.086 (longitude,latitude). The state GIS point is the facility/access anchor; it does not claim a surveyed waterline toe.

controls.name: Otter Creek–Kwonumosk public access area
controls.coordinateText: Official state GIS facility point, OID 238 / id 357; steps access in Weybridge. Coordinate is an access anchor, not a surveyed water-edge location.

reclassifiedProviders.name: Indian River Abanakee Dam to Outer Gooley public-access anchors
reclassifiedProviders.method: NYSDEC identifies the Rafters Parking Area and Indian River whitewater section, the Outer Gooley Hudson access/carry, seasonal roads, and the mandatory boundary before the Hudson Gorge. American Whitewater publishes the distinct Abanakee Dam-to-Hudson reach, direct Indian River gauge, feature hazards, and route-side take-out context. Stored points are public access/waterline anchors; verify dam exclusion, release instructions, road/gate status, carry, landing, parking, and posted private/outfitter boundaries in field.

reclassifiedProviders.name: Maryland Pocomoke River Snow Hill to Shad Landing public access anchors
reclassifiedProviders.method: The Town of Snow Hill identifies Byrd Park as a public Pocomoke River canoe/kayak launch, and Maryland DNR documents Shad Landing as a public state-park boat ramp and soft launch. Coordinates preserve the named town and state-park public access-area anchors; confirm hours, parking, carry, launch surface, events, and current conditions before use.

reclassifiedProviders.name: Maryland Pocomoke River State Park Shad to Milburn public access anchors
reclassifiedProviders.method: Maryland DNR identifies the Shad Landing boat/soft launch, Milburn Landing boat ramp/kayak launch, camping, and the April–mid-December seasonal operation at Milburn; the DNR land-unit plan identifies the Shad–Milburn water trail as 4.5 miles. Coordinates preserve both public park access areas; confirm seasonal operations, parking, carry, and public access-area anchors before use.

reclassifiedProviders.name: New York Saranac River Foot of Kent Falls to Military Turnpike public water-entry controls
reclassifiedProviders.method: American Whitewater identifies the Fisherman’s parking/access area immediately downstream of the Kent Falls Powerhouse and the Military Turnpike parking area between the dam and power-plant intake as the bounded endpoint pair. Current NYSDEC PFR and Saranac River Trail Greenway materials provide public-access and facility context, but the route deliberately excludes the no-legal-access Kent Falls bypass and requires current confirmation of the below-powerhouse carry, river landing, dam exclusion, intake boundary, parking, and operator instructions.

notes: Coordinates are access-area anchors unless the source explicitly identifies a launch-toe coordinate.
Maryland DNR lists possible fall 2026 access limitations during Shad Landing marina construction.
